[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Reorder Data in Log Files** [LC 937 · Reorder Data in Log Files](https://leetcode.com/problems/reorder-data-in-log-files/){difficulty="Medium"}

Two rules here are pure sorting mechanics: a **composite key** (contents first, identifier second) and **stability** (digit-logs must not move relative to each other). The whole problem is a lesson in how you express "sort by these fields, but leave that group alone." Get the key and the stability right and it is one line; get either wrong and the digit-logs shuffle or the tie-break misfires.

[Solved in full in @sec-salgo-p5-a.]{.card-link}
